title: Time-generation callback scheduled-awaitable rejection tests
description: Decomposition of project-LICHEN-worker6-qzxv (persist/clear slice done in parent). Add scheduled Task/Future/custom-awaitable tests for the time-generation elevation callbacks: dio_handler.py:324/338 and link_layer.py:688/699 (peer generation callback) require_sync_callable + reject_awaitable_result — an elevate hook returning asyncio.create_task must raise TypeError, leave the task cancelled and never-run, and the generation transition must not commit. Follow tests/timing/test_time_sync.py::test_provision_persist_hook_rejects_scheduled_awaitable.
close_reason: Completed: 9 new parametrized tests (task/future/custom) pin scheduled-awaitable rejection across all three elevation callbacks the bead names: elevate_authenticated_dio (dio_handler.py:232), elevate_time_generation (:324), and elevate_peer_generation (link_layer.py:688) — each asserts TypeError 'must not return an awaitable' (reject_awaitable_result), terminated state (Task/Future cancelled, custom close_calls==1), and for the time-generation path that the generation transition did not commit (a post-rejection sync retry on the same generation succeeds). Async-correct: tests await link.receive directly instead of the sync issue() helper (which calls asyncio.run), with await asyncio.sleep(0) before cancelled() assertions per the Task cancel-delivery idiom. rpl suite 771 passed; ruff clean. 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (both cancel/close arms of reject_awaitable_result exercised; lease acquire/release balanced so same-generation retry is valid), security PASS (qzxv surface closed in combination with the pre-existing mutated-sentinel test), edge PASS (helper duplication acceptable for test isolation; regex matches all three rejection names).
